intro.heading: Truck support for contractors, builders, and property owners
intro.content: This is Bellhouse dump truck service, not bare truck rental. We send tri-axle trucks with Bellhouse operators to haul excavation spoil out, bring gravel or fill back in, move demolition debris, and keep active jobs from stalling between phases.
keypoints: Bellhouse operator included with every truck
Spoil haul-out and demolition debris removal
Aggregate, fill, and material delivery back to site
Useful for contractor-led work, rural jobs, and larger residential projects

includes.heading: What Bellhouse dump truck service is used for
includes.subheading: Practical hauling support when the site depends on trucks showing up at the right time.

items.title: Excavation Spoil Haul-Out
items.description: We haul out cut material from foundation digs, trenching, pond work, demolition cleanup, and general site excavation.

items.title: Aggregate, Fill, and Material Delivery
items.description: Granular base, gravel, topsoil, fill, and other site materials can be delivered when the next phase needs them.

items.title: Demolition Debris Hauling
items.description: Wood, concrete, rubble, and teardown debris can be loaded and removed as part of structure demolition and site cleanup.

items.title: Jobsite Truck Support
items.description: Useful when builders and contractors need reliable truck cycles tied to excavation, grading, and production schedules.

equipment.heading: Bellhouse tri-axle fleet
equipment.subheading: Road-ready hauling capacity backed by Bellhouse operators and scheduling.

items.title: Tri-Axle Dump Trucks
items.description: Bellhouse tri-axle trucks are used for spoil export, aggregate delivery, demolition debris, and site material movement with legal payloads based on material and road conditions.

process.heading: How Bellhouse truck support works
process.subheading: A straightforward process built around material, access, and the number of truck cycles the job actually needs.

steps.title: Share the material, location, and schedule
steps.description: Tell Bellhouse what needs to be hauled, where the trucks are going, and whether the work is spoil haul-out, delivery, or both.

steps.title: Confirm truck timing and access
steps.description: We review access, load type, disposal or pickup points, and how the trucks need to fit into the rest of the work.

steps.title: Run the hauling plan
steps.description: Bellhouse operators handle the truck cycles so spoil leaves cleanly and imported material arrives when the site is ready.

steps.title: Wrap up the final loads
steps.description: Once the hauling side is complete, the site is left ready for the next crew, the next delivery, or the next construction step.

serviceArea.heading: Service Area
serviceArea.content: Bellhouse dump truck support is available across linked Southern Ontario service areas where excavation, material delivery, and truck timing need to stay coordinated.

items.question: Can I rent a Bellhouse dump truck without an operator?
items.answer: No. Bellhouse provides operator-backed truck service only. The trucks are scheduled with Bellhouse operators so hauling stays tied to the job, the material, and the site conditions.

items.question: Do you only haul spoil, or can you deliver material too?
items.answer: Both. Bellhouse can haul excavated spoil out, then bring gravel, fill, topsoil, or other specified material back in if that is what the project needs next.

items.question: Is this only for contractors?
items.answer: No. Contractor-led work is a common fit, but Bellhouse also supports larger residential, rural, and demolition-related jobs when the access, material, and hauling needs are a good match for tri-axle service.
